name: Benagéber (Spain)
description: White field with three blue wavy stripes across the centre, charged with the crowned arms of Benagéber (a tower above waves and a chequy on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Benagéber; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
